data.standardized_narrative: Unable to extract a definitive gross prior-year reserve movement or opening gross claims outstanding from the provided scanned images. The report contains the relevant tables (balance sheet liabilities 'Claims outstanding' and a gross claims development / earned claims table), but the scanned pages are rotated and low-resolution which prevented reliable numeric extraction of the gross claims outstanding (balance sheet prior-year comparative) and the movement in prior years on a gross basis. A gross claims development triangle is present but its cells were not parsed with sufficient confidence.
data.data_quality_notes: Scanned PDF images are rotated and low-resolution making precise OCR extraction unreliable. Balance sheet 'Claims outstanding' (gross) prior-year comparative column could not be read with confidence. The note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' or equivalent gross movement figure was not unambiguously readable in the scans. A gross claims development (earned gross claims) table is present (page ~30) but individual cell values were not transcribed due to image quality. Where a gross figure was visible for total gross written premiums (247.4) it has been recorded with moderate confidence. If a higher-fidelity (searchable) PDF or original images are provided I can extract exact figures and populate the prior year movement, opening reserves, named events and the claims triangle precisely.
